approvedBy: User approval of the About Us page
rules: Do not redesign the approved About Us page or independently restyle its locked shared components.
Preserve the current desktop and mobile composition, section order, typography, spacing, image crops, cards, navigation hierarchy and dark navy RFQ treatment.
Keep the real catalog factory exterior as the primary company evidence and keep actual product photography tied to the audited product-family data.

Keep the manufacturing and application supporting visuals visibly disclosed as Illustrative scene and described with neutral labels such as Manufacturing process, Cabinet application and Trailer & gate application.
Do not label generated imagery as Our Workshop, Our Production Line, Our Equipment, company staff, a customer installation or other company photographic evidence.
Keep company-specific manufacturing and quality statements limited to their recorded catalog pages unless later verified source evidence expands them.
Keep logistics claims limited to catalog-supported proximity to Shanghai Port and Ningbo Port, convenient highway transportation and personnel responsible for shipment handling.
Do not add shipping-time, delivery-speed, export-volume, destination-country, freight-price, transit-time or annual-export claims.

Do not add founding year, employee count, factory area, revenue, customer count, capacity, patents, certifications, awards, load ratings, tolerances, inspection percentages, MOQ or lead-time claims without new verified evidence.
Preserve the neutral application-selection wording and do not present a hinge family as a definitive best fit without catalog support.
Keep the final RFQ as a local preview until a real submission destination is separately implemented and verified. A future Contact page must not change this locked About Us composition.
